#summary A list of things that should be added and/or have been put off due to laziness.

= General =
  * ~~Something that's already been done.~~
  * Clean up some things that don't allow spaces so that they do.
  * Screen layout should be remembered in a config file.
  * In-character chat characters (which should maybe be renamed - "the characters in the message from the in-character chat character") should also be saved somehow, possibly in the config file
  * The way plugins work is rather jury-rigged; at least the "selecting the plugin multiple times produces multiple instances" should be fixed
  * The logs could do with some prettying-up - it's all just dumped into one big file at the moment
  * Maybe some sort of music or sound support (through Phonon?)

= Network =
  * Fix large image transfer somehow.
    * ~~Maybe this gets fixed by moving the network interface to python?~~
    * ~~Or what about using QStrings as a specific type in python?~~
  * Update protocol documentation so it's actually accurate.
  * Passworded sessions, or other method(s) for controlling who may join

= Interface =
  * ~~Some sort of pallete for pog placement.~~
  * ~~Multiple selection of pogs.~~
  * ~~Better tooltips.~~
  * ~~Dice macros.~~
  * ~~Ability to manipulate widgets better in Python. (E.g., creating new widgets with text/images/maybe buttons)~~
  * ~~"New Map" item in file menu.~~
  * Warning in the join-game dialog that you'll lose current maps and get those the group has loaded.
  * Some sort of dialog designed for displaying information (text and/or images; maybe the same HTML subset as chat would be preferable). For stuff like, say, character sheets. Doesn't need to be editable; probably shouldn't be in fact. Might get rolled into the "widgets" thing.
  * Pog stuff:
    * Ability to assign other kinds of data (perhaps even connect to full character sheets when they're implemented), which may or may not be displayed in the tooltip
    * Think about which commands ought to be in the right-click menu and which in the plugin
    * Automatic resize option(s) of some kind - resize to last used size or something, maybe
  * ~~Option for separate IC/OOC chat.~~
  * Show a green circle (or something else) around pogs if they're selected.
  * CG display system (pops up a box with a large picture, most likely)
  * Multiple map layers which the camera and pogs can easily switch between
  * Ability to change an existing map's tileset
  * From Kaijyuu: it would be nice if the eraser showed some indicator of the area you're erasing while in use
  * From Kaijyuu: pog placement could be made more intuitive

= Game Support =
  * Designate "DM" user
  * Allow DM to request dice rolls from players
  * "Display Grid" option - separate from tileset size; square and hex grids (and other weird shapes if there's any evidence they've been used)
  * Option to snap pogs to grid
  * Some sort of distance-measuring in conjunction with grid (e.g. at minimum, able to measure that it's 10 grid units from point A to point B)
    * Would be nice to support display in other unit forms - defining that e.g. 10 pixels or 1 grid unit represents a metre, or so forth
    * Would be nice, if a (square) grid is used, to be able to specify the metric - Euclidean, Manhattan, Chebyshev, and whatever D&D 3.5's metric is called
  * Fog of War
    * Probably makes the most sense in conjunction with a grid - however, it seems possible to have an "only show pogs within X range of a pog" even without a grid?
    * Ability to specify which tiles or tile types block sight for different vision types
    * Ability to define arbitrary vision types for the above purpose
      * Options for different vision types - whether to calculate centre-to-centre etc.
  * Camera lock to a particular pog or so forth
    * Alternate control schemes, like using arrow keys or WASD to move a pog

= Graphics =
  * Some default tilesets would be nice.
  * Some default pogs would be nice.
  * Animated tiles.
  * Be able to draw ~~points, lines,~~ rectangles, curves or circles, etc.

= Generators =
  * Add more name generators.
  * Techniquename generator should produce much cooler content.
  * Pog generator.
  * Quest/Story generator.
  * Character generator.

= Awesome =
  * Add Cirno. (Probably as a plugin due to memory consumption.)

= Bugs =
  * Deleting pogs apparently sometimes deletes the wrong ones.
  * Files in general don't always seem to be sent.
  * Erase works strangely in some cases, especially if there's no map (should you even be able to draw without a map?)
